datasets.name: ds_unresolved_risk
datasets.displayName: Unresolved PRs by predicted breach risk
queryLines:
WITH horizon AS (
  -- The SCORED population's own horizon, not the fact table's. Gold
  -- now holds two disjoint windows (Phase 8 Task 7 landed 2026-09-05
  -- beside Q3 2025) and predictions cover only the older one, so an
  -- unscoped max(opened_at) sat 340 days past the newest PR this panel
  -- can rank and inflated every minutes_open_at_horizon by ~490,000.
  -- It still returned 200 healthy-looking rows, which is why it has a test.
  SELECT max(f.opened_at) AS as_of
  FROM almanac_dbx.features.pr_breach_predictions p
  JOIN almanac_dbx.gold.fact_pull_request f
    ON f.repo_id = p.repo_id AND f.pr_number = p.pr_number
)
SELECT p.repo_id, p.pr_number, p.breach_risk, p.is_bot_author,
       f.opened_at,
       timestampdiff(MINUTE, f.opened_at, h.as_of) AS minutes_open_at_horizon
FROM almanac_dbx.features.pr_breach_predictions p
JOIN almanac_dbx.gold.fact_pull_request f
  ON f.repo_id = p.repo_id AND f.pr_number = p.pr_number
CROSS JOIN horizon h
WHERE f.closed_at IS NULL
ORDER BY p.breach_risk DESC
LIMIT 200

datasets.name: ds_calibration
datasets.displayName: Calibration: predicted risk vs observed breach rate
queryLines:
SELECT risk_decile,
       round(avg(breach_risk), 4) AS mean_predicted,
       round(avg(CASE WHEN breach THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END), 4) AS observed_rate,
       count(*) AS pull_requests
FROM (SELECT breach_risk, breach,
             ntile(10) OVER (ORDER BY breach_risk) AS risk_decile
      FROM almanac_dbx.features.pr_breach_predictions)
GROUP BY risk_decile
ORDER BY risk_decile

datasets.name: ds_risk_by_repo
queryLines:
SELECT repo_id,
       count(*) AS pull_requests,
       round(avg(breach_risk), 4) AS mean_risk,
       round(avg(CASE WHEN breach THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END), 4) AS observed_breach_rate
FROM almanac_dbx.features.pr_breach_predictions
GROUP BY repo_id
HAVING count(*) >= 50
ORDER BY mean_risk DESC
LIMIT 100

datasets.name: ds_predicted_vs_actual
queryLines:
SELECT is_bot_author,
       count(*) AS pull_requests,
       round(avg(breach_risk), 4) AS mean_predicted_risk,
       round(avg(CASE WHEN breach THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END), 4) AS observed_breach_rate
FROM almanac_dbx.features.pr_breach_predictions
GROUP BY is_bot_author

widget.name: w1_header
widget.textbox_spec:
# Review SLA Risk

Which open pull requests are most likely to breach the **1,487 s** review-latency expectation (§5.3's measured p75), ranked so a human can intervene while it still matters.

**Scores are batch, not live.** The serving endpoint returns a class, not a probability, so these come from `almanac.model.score` over the historical quarter using the same registered champion. Age is measured to the data's own horizon -- the latest `opened_at` among *scored* PRs, not the latest in Gold, which since Phase 8 Task 7 also holds an unscored 2026 window -- never wall-clock. The quarter is historical, so a wall-clock age would read the same large number for every row. See `docs/limitations.md`.
